# pocketpull

> pocketpull downloads your Pocket recordings (transcripts, metadata and summaries) into a local folder. Each run collects once and exits; cron runs it on a schedule.

- Written in Go; ships as a single static Linux binary (amd64/arm64) with nothing else to install.
- Read-only towards Pocket: it never changes or deletes anything upstream, and never deletes local copies.
- Configured with one YAML file plus flags; the API key comes from an environment variable or a private file.

- [Configuration and credentials](docs/usage/configuration.md): flags, config file lookup, YAML keys, API key sources
- [Collection behaviour](docs/usage/collection.md): when recordings are refetched, where files are written, retries and recovery
- [Cron scheduling](docs/operations/scheduling.md): set up unattended runs
- [Logs and exit status](docs/operations/logging.md): log formats, summary fields, exit codes
